correctionStatus.title: Correction request status

hints.Draft: This request has not been sent yet.
hints.Submitted: The request is waiting for review.
hints.Reviewing: A reviewer is looking at the request.
hints.NeedInfo: The reviewer asked for more information; reply.
hints.Accepted: Accepted. The catalog may change; past invoices and receipts stay as they were.
hints.Rejected: Rejected. You can appeal with an explanation or new evidence.
hints.Appealed: The appeal is recorded and the request is reviewed again.
hints.Withdrawn: The request was withdrawn; your store product did not change.
